name: Algebra 1 Recurring + Assessment Resource Profile
role: Course-specific Warm-Up / Exit / Progress / Review / Summative behavior. Shared PMs own procedure and rendering mechanics; this profile owns Algebra-specific behavior.

warmups.days_rule: Build three daily Warm-Ups per section by default unless the current teacher request/calendar explicitly changes the count.
warmups.architecture: Every daily Algebra Warm-Up uses four stable jobs; it is a separate fluency track, not a Current/Review/Mastery sampler.

slots.Q1 Solve / Equation Fluency: Compact solving mini-set. Course progression: one-step -> mixed one-step -> two-step -> combining like terms -> distribution -> multi-step -> variables both sides -> rational coefficients -> cumulative mix. Older types remain mixed.
slots.Q2 Diamond / Factoring Pattern: Product-sum number reasoning -> integer factor pairs -> factoring trinomials -> special factoring patterns.
slots.Q3 Skill Review: Foundational rotation: fractions, integers, order of operations, distribution, combining like terms, substitution/evaluation, exponent laws, function notation, and useful upcoming prerequisites.
slots.Q4 Challenge: Reasoning/pattern/generalization/error analysis/representation/nonroutine problem; not merely harder arithmetic.

warmups.calculator_language: For fraction/integer fluency, encourage trying without a calculator first while clearly allowing calculator use if needed.
warmups.layout: Preserve the tested four-slot Notability layout unless a later visual decision changes it.
warmups.question_structure_exception: Warm-Ups do not use the universal Question Structure requirement; follow the four stable fluency jobs and the Framework progression map.

exit_tickets.menu: One official Exit Ticket link per section. Retire A/B/C as three canonical stage tickets.
exit_tickets.new_slot_rule: Use the two new evidence opportunities assigned by the coursewide Exit evidence map; do not remap them downstream.
exit_tickets.repeat_slot_rule: Use the two fresh parallel reassessment questions authored in the canonical Bank for the previous section carryforward pair. Preserve the evidence target and useful difficulty.
exit_tickets.cross_unit_rule: Unit N Section 1 normally reassesses Unit N-1 Section 5.
exit_tickets.u1_1_exception: U1.1 uses four new U1-MG01 readiness/mastery evidence questions. Q1-Q2 are the carryforward pair for U1.2; Q3-Q4 are additional opening evidence.
exit_tickets.intro_review_rule: Intro and Review evidence is primarily formative during instruction. If the teacher wants a focused Intro/Review check, generate a small reteach/recovery check on demand; it is not automatically official/canonical portfolio evidence.
exit_tickets.layout: One full viewport with four questions in a 2x2 grid; prompt before representation; no visible internal metadata.

progress_tracker.organization: Mastery Goal -> supporting exact I Can statements -> portfolio evidence -> current evidence status -> next move

review.target_rule: Unit Review prepares the CURRENT Unit Mastery Goals/supporting I Cans and does not mean the Section Spiral Review stage.

summative.source_rule: Render the six secure canonical Bank forms authored under the accepted Summative blueprint. Do not regenerate them downstream.
summative.time: Evidence/time driven; exact form length comes from the accepted Bank Map/Bank.

targeted_reteach_check.targets: Intro, Review, misconception, or recently retaught skill
targeted_reteach_check.canonical_status: Not automatically an official Exit Ticket, Bank requirement, or portfolio event.
